glossary.NATS: an open-source messaging system (its name is not an abbreviation of anything longer here)
glossary.REST: representational state transfer, the style of most web APIs
glossary.CRD: CustomResourceDefinition, which adds a new resource type to Kubernetes
glossary.SHA: a commit's hash, which identifies it

checks.what: Two independent audits read all 522 cards against the Argo CD, Workflows, Rollouts and Events documentation they quote, word for word as found by the card checker
checks.result: 3 wrong cards (a rollback-window scenario with no right answer, and two scenarios whose wrong options were explained wrongly) were fixed and rechecked against their sources; 6 unsupported claims, 2 ambiguous cards, 8 unclear ones and 5 minor issues were also fixed.
